notes.text: What to watch at 7 pm: Dallas County posts its early vote first, usually 7:30 to 8, then Election Day from about 9. In 2022 the Democrat led Commissioner Precinct 2's early vote by 13,295 and the Republican won its Election Day by 1,438, so read the two separately. Statewide, early votes from the big urban counties post first and lean Democratic; Election Day votes lean Republican, so early margins usually narrow through the night.
